# front-template-angular

A clone-and-go Angular frontend template: standalone components, Signals,
zoneless change detection, SSR, Tailwind CSS v4, a copy-in UI kit, and
client-side auth against a REST API.

## Stack
Angular (standalone, zoneless, strict TS) · Angular SSR (Node/Express) ·
Tailwind CSS v4 · Angular CDK · ngx-translate (en/pt) · Zod (env + form
validation) · Jest · Playwright · ESLint + Prettier · Docker.

## Structure
- src/app/core — cross-cutting services (ApiClient, AuthService, ThemeService,
  LocaleService, ToastService, SeoService) and the Zod validator bridge.
- src/app/shared — the copy-in UI kit (Button, TextField, Card, Dialog, Toast)
  and the Header/Footer/LocaleSwitcher/ThemeToggle shell components.
- src/app/features — routed pages: home, auth (login/register/forgot/reset),
  dashboard, account, notes (example CRUD with CDK Table).

## Auth
Client-side only. `AuthService` calls a REST API at `API_BASE_URL`:
`POST /auth/login` (returns `{ accessToken }`, user identity decoded
client-side from the JWT payload), `POST /auth/register` (returns
`{ id, email }`, no auto-login — email verification is a separate step),
`POST /auth/forgot-password`, `POST /auth/reset-password`,
`PATCH /account/password`, `DELETE /account` (requires the current password
in the body). A single `authGuard` protects `/dashboard`, `/account`, `/notes`.

## Contact / source
See the repository README for setup, environment variables, and design notes.
